Waar gaat het in de praktijk mis?: Where does the process break down in practice?
We brengen het huidige proces, de gebrui: We map your current process, systems, exceptions and costs. Only then do we advise whether an off-the-shelf solution, a custom integration or another approach makes sense.
Orders, relaties of uren worden nog hand: Orders, customers or time entries are still copied into AFAS manually. Which data need to flow where, who checks exceptions and how can you avoid duplicate entries?
Je webshop, verkoop en administratie geb: Your webshop, sales and accounts use different customer, product or invoice data. An integration only helps when error handling and ownership are addressed too.
Facturen, bankmutaties en verkoopgegeven: Invoices, bank transactions and sales records arrive at different times. Start with the source data and checks your accounts actually need.
Er bestaan dashboards, maar definities,: You have dashboards, but metric definitions, source data and decisions do not align. Who uses which KPI to make real decisions?
Een order in je webshop betekent nog nie: An order in your webshop does not mean inventory, customer and invoice data are correct in your accounts. Check the full data flow and its exceptions.
Hetzelfde werk komt elke week terug: ove: The same tasks recur every week: retyping, checking, waiting and fixing. First identify which step demonstrably wastes time or causes errors.
Twee systemen kunnen technisch gegevens: Two systems may exchange data technically, but that does not make the process reliable. Define the source of truth and who resolves errors first.
Afspraken en werkinstructies zitten vers: Agreements and work instructions are scattered across people's heads, documents and systems. What must a colleague be able to find without asking?
Een AI-pilot levert pas iets op als de b: An AI pilot only adds value if the source data are reliable, someone is accountable and the output is used in the actual workflow.
Welke handmatige stap veroorzaakt vertra: Which manual step causes delays, rework or loss of knowledge? First make the cause, owner and desired result concrete.
